reference: Do not worry, the plane will stop at the right gate.
sk: Neboj sa, lietadlo zastane pri správnej bráne.
cz: Neboj se, letadlo zastaví u správné brány.
acceptable: {Do not worry|Do not be afraid}, the {plane|airplane|aeroplane} will stop at the {right|correct} gate.

mistakes.text: Do not worry, the plane stops at the {right|correct} gate.
Do not worry, the plane is going to stop at the {right|correct} gate.
Do not worry, the plane will stops at the {right|correct} gate.
Do not worry, the plane will stop on the {right|correct} gate.
Not worry, the plane will stop at the {right|correct} gate.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Zápor príkazu tvorí „do not“: „Do not worry“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Zápor rozkazu tvoří „do not“: „Do not worry“.

mistakes.text: Do not worry you, the plane will stop at the {right|correct} gate.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Neboj sa“ je len „Do not worry“, bez „you“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Neboj se“ je jen „Do not worry“, bez „you“.
